TC05.title: [CLI]Verify ""Update URL"" and  ""Update URL Period"" can be set via CLI
TC05.steps:
1.Login FW via CLI
2.Commands as followed:
config(18C2418A2034)# interface tun   
config(18C2418A2034)# tun          
config(18C2418A2034)# tunnel-interface 
  4to6    ipv6    vpn     
config(18C2418A2034)# tunnel-interface 4to6 JPIX
(edit-tunnel-interface[JPIX])# sho current-config 
    type v6plus
        local-ipv4 192.0.0.10
        bound-to interface X1
        local dynamic
        remote ipv6 2001:470:80b7:896:1:2:3:4
        exit

    flow-reporting
    fragment-packets
    no ignore-df-bit
    send-icmp-fragmentation
    no comment
(edit-tunnel-interface[JPIX])# type v6plus 
(edit-v6plus-tunnel[JPIX])# update-url http://[2001:470:80b7:896:250:56ff:feb4:e631]
(edit-v6plus-tunnel[JPIX])# update-url-period 43200
(edit-v6plus-tunnel[JPIX])# commit
(edit-v6plus-tunnel[JPIX])# exi
(edit-tunnel-interface[JPIX])# sho cu
    type v6plus
        local-ipv4 192.0.0.10
        bound-to interface X1
        local dynamic
        remote ipv6 2001:470:80b7:896:1:2:3:4
        update-url http://[2001:470:80b7:896:250:56ff:feb4:e631]
        update-url-period 43200
        exit

    flow-reporting
    fragment-packets
    no ignore-df-bit
    send-icmp-fragmentation
    no comment
TC05.expected result: Check GUI, the correct parameter shows, and the led became green with the correct details
